text: Using the glossary default metric failure_rate_by_reason and INR reporting currency, Chennai payment failure rates from 2026-09-03 to 2026-09-09 were issuer_declined 5.8%, authentication_failed 3.6%, network_timeout 3.6%, invalid_details 3.2%, risk_blocked 2.8%, insufficient_funds 2.7%, and expired_card 2.4%.
